readings.plain: Every request has an active response at its own step.
Every request has an active response at some strictly later step.

requirement: A request at the starting step requires an active response.

readings.plain: A starting-step request requires the response at the starting step.
A starting-step request requires the response strictly later.

requirement: There must be a request with an active response.

readings.plain: Some request coincides with an active response.
Some request has an active response strictly later.

requirement: Requests with an active response must keep occurring.

readings.plain: Infinitely many requests coincide with an active response.
Infinitely many requests have an active response strictly later.

requirement: Eventually, requests must always have an active response.

readings.plain: From some point onward, each request coincides with an active response.
From some point onward, each request has an active response strictly later.

requirement: Requests require an active response until a release occurs, and a release must occur.

readings.plain: Before the first release, every request coincides with an active response; a release occurs.
Before the first release, every request has an active response strictly later; a release occurs.

requirement: Requests require an active response unless and until a release occurs.

readings.plain: Every request before the first release, or forever if no release occurs, coincides with an active response.
Every request before the first release, or forever if no release occurs, has an active response strictly later.

requirement: From the first release onward, requests require an active response.

readings.plain: At and after the first release, every request coincides with an active response.
At and after the first release, every request has an active response strictly later.

requirement: Every request requires a response that remains active forever.

readings.plain: For each request, the response is active from the request step forever.
For each request, the response is active forever starting at some strictly later step.

requirement: Every request requires the response to stay active until a release, which must occur.

readings.plain: Each request starts a requirement for activity at that step and until a release occurs.
Each request has a strictly later step starting a requirement for activity then and until a release occurs.

requirement: A request at the next step requires an active response.

readings.plain: A request exactly one step from the start requires a response at that same step.
A request exactly one step from the start requires a response at some step after it.

requirement: Requests made while the response is permitted require an active response.

readings.plain: Every request made when permission holds coincides with an active response.
Every request made when permission holds has an active response strictly later.
